text: Today I will show you the fastest way to plan a week of content.
So before we begin, here is basically the story behind this workflow.
Before we begin, there is just one more piece of context.
First, capture every idea in one place and score it by audience intent.
Then group related ideas into a sequence so each upload creates demand for the next.
The scoring step is the payoff: evidence replaces the blank page.
Finally, keep the strongest hook and schedule the week.
